description: [1/5] Store integrity: corrupt-line error model, strict base64, parse-before-write, directory fsync

impact_assessment.why: Stage-2 verification confirmed 14 real gaps in the shipped Postbox; the highest-impact ones let malformed input crash server threads and turn a corrupt line into an orphan append.
impact_assessment.benefits: A corrupt inbox produces a clear error instead of a traceback, and state survives power loss after file creation or atomic replacement.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: F09 moves /__clear off GET, so callers and README must change together; dependency: stdlib-only, no new packages; concurrency: parse-before-write must stay inside the existing lock or a trim could race an append; state: directory fsync must degrade safely on platforms without it.
impact_assessment.mitigation: One ADR and README table per contract change; raw-socket and direct-call failing-first tests for every branch; keep all store mutations under the existing lock; guard directory fsync with a platform-safe fallback; finish with check --strict.
